title: PENGU surges 14% on ‘Pengu Minibot’ hype – But $1.5M squeeze hints at…
summary: PENGU overtook TRUMP as rising leverage and buying pressure pushed price toward the $0.012 resistance.
content: PENGU surged 14% amid significant hype surrounding the 'Pengu Minibot'. The cryptocurrency successfully overtook TRUMP as rising leverage and intense buying pressure propelled its price closer to the $0.012 resistance level. However, analysts note that a notable $1.5 million squeeze hints at potential risks ahead for traders navigating this volatile market movement.
content_ta: 'Pengu Minibot' குறித்த உற்சாகத்தால் PENGU விலை 14% உயர்ந்தது. அதிகரித்து வரும் அந்நியச் செலாவணி மற்றும் வாங்கும் அழுத்தம் காரணமாக இதன் விலை $0.012 எதிர்ப்பை நோக்கி நகர்ந்ததால், இது TRUMP-ஐ முந்தியது. இருப்பினும், $1.5 மில்லியன் அளவிலான ஒரு சிறிய சந்தை அழுத்தம் வரவிருக்கும் அபாயங்களை குறிப்பதாக ஆய்வாளர்கள் தெரிவிக்கின்றனர்.

title: Trustly slashes 200 jobs
summary: Swedish open banking outfit Trustly is cutting a quarter of its staff as part of an effort to cut costs and prioritise profitable growth markets.
content: Swedish open banking firm Trustly has announced a significant workforce reduction, cutting 200 jobs. This move represents a quarter of the company's total staff. The decision is part of a broader corporate strategy aimed at reducing operational costs and focusing resources on markets that offer profitable growth. The company seeks to streamline its operations to maintain a stronger financial position during the current economic climate.
content_ta: சுவீடனைச் சேர்ந்த ஓபன் பேங்கிங் நிறுவனமான Trustly, தனது பணியாளர்களில் கால் பகுதியை குறைப்பதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இதன்படி 200 ஊழியர்கள் பணிநீக்கம் செய்யப்படுகின்றனர். செலவுகளைக் குறைக்கவும், லாபகரமான சந்தைகளில் அதிக கவனம் செலுத்தவும் இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளதாக நிறுவனம் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. தற்போதைய பொருளாதார சூழலில், நிறுவனத்தின் நிதி நிலையை வலுப்படுத்தவும், செயல்பாடுகளை முறைப்படுத்தவும் இந்த முக்கிய முடிவை Trustly எடுத்துள்ளது.

title: Former Visa crypto lead launches open payments network
summary: Atum, an open payments network founded by former Visa crypto product team lead Pete Cooling, has emerged from stealth with $13.5 million in funding.
content: Atum, an open payments network, has officially launched after emerging from stealth mode. Founded by Pete Cooling, the former lead of the Visa crypto product team, the company successfully secured $13.5 million in funding. The project aims to develop a new infrastructure for payments, leveraging Cooling's background in the payments sector to innovate within the industry.
content_ta: Visa நிறுவனத்தின் முன்னாள் கிரிப்டோ தயாரிப்பு பிரிவு தலைவரான Pete Cooling, Atum என்ற புதிய ஓப்பன் பேமெண்ட்ஸ் நெட்வொர்க்கைத் தொடங்கியுள்ளார். ஸ்டெல்த் முறையில் இயங்கி வந்த இந்த நிறுவனம், தற்போது 13.5 மில்லியன் டாலர் முதலீட்டைத் திரட்டியுள்ளது. பேமெண்ட்ஸ் துறையில் தனது அனுபவத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி, நவீன கட்டண உள்கட்டமைப்பை உருவாக்குவதை Atum நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: MyComplianceOffice lands over $100m strategic investment
summary: MyComplianceOffice (MCO), a provider of compliance management software for the financial services industry, has secured over $100 million in strategic growth financing from Accel-KKR Credit Partners.
content: MyComplianceOffice, a company specializing in compliance management software for the financial services industry, has successfully secured a strategic growth investment exceeding $100 million. This significant funding was provided by Accel-KKR Credit Partners. The company plans to use this capital injection to further develop its technological solutions and expand its reach within the compliance market, reinforcing its commitment to helping financial firms manage regulatory requirements more effectively.
content_ta: நிதிச் சேவைத் துறையில் இணக்க மேலாண்மை மென்பொருளை வழங்கும் MyComplianceOffice நிறுவனம், $100 மில்லியனுக்கும் அதிகமான முதலீட்டைத் திரட்டியுள்ளது. இந்த முக்கிய முதலீட்டை Accel-KKR Credit Partners வழங்கியுள்ளது. இந்நிறுவனம் தனது தொழில்நுட்பத் தீர்வுகளை மேம்படுத்தவும், இணக்க மேலாண்மை சந்தையில் தனது செயல்பாடுகளை விரிவுபடுத்தவும் இந்த நிதியைப் பயன்படுத்தத் திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது. நிதி நிறுவனங்கள் தங்கள் ஒழுங்குமுறைத் தேவைகளைச் சிறப்பாகக் கையாளுவதற்குத் தேவையான ஆதரவை மேலும் வலுப்படுத்த இந்த முதலீடு உதவும்.

title: Britain's Banks Pick Tokenized Deposits Over Stablecoins. Here's Why the BoE Is Cheering
summary:
UK banks complete first interbank transfer of tokenised deposits as the Bank of England favors bank tokens over stablecoins.
The post Britain's Banks Pick Tokenized Deposits Over Stablecoins. Here's Why the BoE Is Cheering appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: UK banks have successfully completed their first interbank transfer using tokenized deposits. This development comes as the Bank of England increasingly favors tokenized bank deposits over public stablecoins for future financial systems. The central bank has expressed strong support for this approach, highlighting potential benefits for the stability and efficiency of the nation's banking infrastructure.
content_ta: UK வங்கிகள் முதல்முறையாக tokenized deposits-ஐப் பயன்படுத்தி interbank transfer-ஐ வெற்றிகரமாக முடித்துள்ளன. எதிர்கால நிதி அமைப்புகளுக்கு public stablecoins-ஐ விட tokenized bank deposits-க்கு Bank of England ஆதரவளிப்பதன் மூலம் இந்த வளர்ச்சி ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. நாட்டின் வங்கிக் கட்டமைப்பின் ஸ்திரத்தன்மை மற்றும் செயல்திறனுக்கான சாத்தியமான நன்மைகளைச் சுட்டிக்காட்டி, மத்திய வங்கி இதற்கு தனது வலுவான ஆதரவைத் தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

title: Trump Has a New Crypto Plan to Reduce America’s $40 Trillion Debt
summary:
The Trump administration is considering a push to expand US dollar stablecoins overseas, according to Bloomberg. The idea could bring more foreign money into US government debt while making digital dollars easier to use around the world. The timing is important as US national debt passed $40 trillion last month. The Plan: Get More of
The post Trump Has a New Crypto Plan to Reduce America’s $40 Trillion Debt appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: The Trump administration is reportedly considering a plan to expand US dollar stablecoins internationally. This strategy aims to increase foreign demand for US government debt while promoting digital dollar adoption globally. The proposal comes as the United States national debt recently surpassed the $40 trillion threshold.
content_ta: டிரம்ப் நிர்வாகம் US dollar stablecoins-களை சர்வதேச அளவில் விரிவுபடுத்துவதற்கான ஒரு திட்டத்தை பரிசீலித்து வருவதாக கூறப்படுகிறது. அமெரிக்க தேசிய கடன் சமீபத்தில் $40 trillion வரம்பை தாண்டியுள்ள நிலையில், இந்த உத்தியானது அமெரிக்க அரசாங்கத்தின் கடனுக்கான வெளிநாட்டு தேவையை அதிகரிக்கும் நோக்கம் கொண்டது.

title: Coinbase CEO warns against banks lending deposits without consent
summary:
Armstrong's warning highlights potential shifts in financial trust, prompting scrutiny of banking practices and stablecoin regulation impacts.
The post Coinbase CEO warns against banks lending deposits without consent appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong has issued a warning regarding the practice of traditional banks lending out customer deposits without explicit consent. His comments emphasize growing concerns over financial transparency and the potential risks inherent in current banking systems. This discourse highlights the evolving relationship between centralized banking institutions and the broader crypto market, suggesting a need for increased regulatory scrutiny regarding how financial entities manage client funds.
content_ta: Coinbase நிறுவனத்தின் CEO Brian Armstrong, வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் அனுமதியின்றி வங்கிகள் அவர்களின் வைப்புத் தொகையை கடன் கொடுக்கும் நடைமுறை குறித்து எச்சரிக்கை விடுத்துள்ளார். நிதி வெளிப்படைத்தன்மை மற்றும் தற்போதைய வங்கி முறைகளில் உள்ள அபாயங்கள் குறித்து அவர் கவலை தெரிவித்துள்ளார். இந்த விவாதம், வங்கி நிறுவனங்களுக்கும் கிரிப்டோ சந்தைக்கும் இடையிலான உறவை வெளிப்படுத்துவதோடு, வாடிக்கையாளர் நிதியை நிர்வகிப்பதில் கூடுதல் ஒழுங்குமுறை கட்டுப்பாடுகள் தேவை என்பதை வலியுறுத்துகிறது.

title: Bitcoin Drops to $84K as Bond Yields Hit 5.11%: What Next?
summary:
The post Bitcoin Drops to $84K as Bond Yields Hit 5.11%: What Next? appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News
Bitcoin (BTC) has shed 2.06% in value in the day, missing the $87,000 resistance line and pulling back to $84,425 at press time. Other than rising speculations of increased aggressiveness in the Middle East conflict, the drop is also a short-term consequence of the recent hike in US government bond yields. Bitcoin drops amid spike …
content: Bitcoin has declined by over 2% to trade near $84,425, failing to break the $87,000 resistance level. Market analysts attribute this downturn to rising tensions in the Middle East and a notable increase in US government bond yields, which hit 5.11%. The cryptocurrency market remains sensitive to these macroeconomic shifts and geopolitical concerns as investors monitor potential price movements.
content_ta: Bitcoin மதிப்பு 2 சதவீதத்திற்கும் மேலாக சரிந்து சுமார் $84,425 என்ற அளவில் வர்த்தகமாகிறது. $87,000 என்ற எதிர்ப்பு நிலையைத் தாண்டத் தவறியதே இந்த வீழ்ச்சிக்குக் காரணமாகும். மத்திய கிழக்கு பிராந்தியத்தில் நிலவும் பதற்றமான சூழல் மற்றும் அமெரிக்க அரசு பத்திரங்களின் வட்டி விகிதம் 5.11 சதவீதமாக உயர்ந்தது போன்றவை இந்த சரிவுக்கு முக்கிய காரணங்களாகக் கருதப்படுகின்றன. உலகளாவிய பொருளாதார மாற்றங்களால் இந்த விலை ஏற்ற இறக்கம் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Stitch Fix AI Try-Ons Drive Surge in Shopper Spend
summary:
Online personal styling service Stitch Fix is seeing a “significant lift” in spending from clients who engage with its tool that lets them see artificial intelligence-generated images of themselves wearing the outfits they’re considering, Stitch Fix CEO Matt Baer said during a Wednesday (Sept. 23) earnings call. Stitch Fix announced in June that it expanded […]
The post Stitch Fix AI Try-Ons Drive Surge in Shopper Spend appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Stitch Fix has reported a notable increase in consumer spending driven by its new artificial intelligence-powered virtual try-on feature. According to CEO Matt Baer, customers interacting with the AI-generated imagery are choosing to purchase outfits at higher rates. The company, which launched the expansion of this tool earlier this year, noted that the technology is successfully enhancing the personal styling experience and encouraging greater engagement from its client base.
content_ta: Stitch Fix நிறுவனம் தனது புதிய செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) மூலம் இயங்கும் வர்ச்சுவல் ட்ரை-ஆன் (virtual try-on) வசதியால் வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் செலவு கணிசமாக அதிகரித்துள்ளதாக தெரிவித்துள்ளது. நிறுவனத்தின் CEO Matt Baer, இந்த AI தொழில்நுட்பத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி ஆடைகளை முயற்சித்துப் பார்க்கும் வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் அதிகளவில் பொருட்களை வாங்குவதாகக் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார். இந்த வசதி வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு ஆடைத் தேர்வை எளிதாக்குவதுடன், நிறுவனத்தின் விற்பனையையும் மேம்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Binance Adds New Spot Grid And DCA Trading Bot Support
summary: TL;DR Binance has expanded automated Spot Grid and Spot DCA bot support to additional trading pairs. The new services became effective September 22 at 08:00 UTC. The bots automate user-defined strategies; they do not guarantee profitable trading. Binance is expanding the part of its spot platform designed to run without a trader manually clicking every […]
content: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has expanded its automated Spot Grid and Spot DCA trading bot support to additional trading pairs. The new services became effective on September 22. These bots are designed to help users automate their defined trading strategies, though the platform reminds traders that automation does not guarantee profitability. Binance continues to grow its suite of automated trading tools for spot market users.
content_ta: க்ரிப்டோகரன்சி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்ச் ஆன Binance, தனது ஆட்டோமேட்டெட் Spot Grid மற்றும் Spot DCA டிரேடிங் பாட் ஆதரவை கூடுதல் டிரேடிங் ஜோடிகளுக்கு விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய சேவைகள் செப்டம்பர் 22 முதல் அமலுக்கு வந்தன. இந்த பாட்கள் பயனர்கள் தங்கள் சொந்த டிரேடிங் வியூகங்களை ஆட்டோமேட் செய்ய உதவும் வகையில் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன, இருப்பினும் ஆட்டோமேஷன் மூலம் லாபம் கிடைக்கும் என்பதற்கு எந்த உத்தரவாதமும் இல்லை என்று பிளாட்ஃபார்ம் நினைவூட்டுகிறது.

title: a16z seeks SEC exemption for DEXs – Could TradFi push back?
summary: The industry wants SEC to make a stand on the recently contested DeFi developer protections.
content: Venture capital firm a16z has petitioned the SEC to grant regulatory exemptions for decentralized exchanges, or DEXs. The move aims to secure legal protections for software developers building DeFi platforms, who currently face increasing regulatory scrutiny. As the industry pushes for clearer frameworks, potential pushback from traditional financial institutions remains a major point of concern regarding how decentralized protocols will eventually coexist with established market structures.
content_ta: Venture capital நிறுவனமான a16z, decentralized exchanges (DEXs) செயல்பாடுகளுக்கு regulatory exemptions வழங்கக்கோரி SEC-இடம் மனு அளித்துள்ளது. DeFi தளங்களை உருவாக்கும் மென்பொருள் உருவாக்குநர்களுக்கு சட்டப் பாதுகாப்பு வழங்குவதே இந்த முயற்சியின் நோக்கம். இந்தத் துறை தெளிவான சட்ட கட்டமைப்புகளைக் கோரும் நிலையில், பாரம்பரிய நிதி நிறுவனங்களின் எதிர்ப்பு காரணமாக, பரவலாக்கப்பட்ட நெறிமுறைகள் மற்றும் சந்தை கட்டமைப்புகளுக்கு இடையே உள்ள எதிர்கால ஒருங்கிணைப்பு குறித்த கவலைகள் எழுந்துள்ளன.

title: Replit CEO warns startups of risks from major AI model providers
summary:
AI startups face increased competition from major model providers, necessitating diversification and innovation to maintain market relevance.
The post Replit CEO warns startups of risks from major AI model providers appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Replit CEO Amjad Masad has cautioned AI-focused startups regarding the strategic risks posed by major foundation model providers. As these large tech companies integrate more features into their core offerings, smaller startups face significant competition. Masad suggests that to remain competitive and relevant in the evolving artificial intelligence landscape, businesses must focus on unique innovation and avoid over-reliance on a single model provider.

title: A week of AI coding cut a quantum-safe bitcoin transaction estimate from $320 to $66

title: Chainlink Releases Node v2.65.0 With Confidential Workflow Monitoring Fix
summary: TL;DR Aptos Labs has released mainnet node software v1.49.1 for validators and fullnode operators. The release follows the earlier v1.49.1 hotfix path and rolls a wider set of execution, consensus and state-sync changes into the public mainnet build. End users do not need to migrate tokens or take wallet action. Aptos node operators have a new production release to work through after the project published mainnet node software v1.49.1. The release is aimed squarely at infrastructure operators rather than ordinary APT holders. It packages a broad set of changes across execution, consensus, storage and state sync, while also rolling forward fixes that had previously appeared in the v1.49 hotfix path. Validators Get A Broader Mainnet Build The v1.49.1 release is more than a cosmetic version bump. The change log includes work around state sync, validator recovery, execution consistency, database handling and the Move environment. It also incorporates fixes that arrived during the v1.49 release cycle, giving operators a more complete public build rather than relying indefinitely on an emergency hotfix branch. That distinction matters for validators. A private or narrowly distributed hotfix can keep a network stable in the short term, but operators eventually need a standard release they can deploy and maintain in a predictable way. For fullnode providers, indexers and RPC operators, the release also gives a common software target as the network moves beyond the earlier patch. This Is Infrastructure Work, Not A User-Facing Fork Nothing in the release requires APT holders to swap tokens, update wallet balances or interact with a migration contract. The practical work sits with validators and node operators. That is an important distinction because blockchain software releases are often described as network “upgrades” even when the user experience changes very little. In this case, the value is operational: keeping validator software aligned, tightening execution behavior and carrying fixes into the mainline release path. Aptos has been moving quickly through its 1.49 series, and v1.49.1 gives operators a cleaner production baseline after the hotfix cycle. For users, the best outcome is almost invisible — a network that continues running without asking them to do anything at all. The release also gives infrastructure providers a better point from which to plan the next maintenance window. Operators that delayed moving onto the private hotfix now have a public release path with a broader changelog behind it. That can reduce version fragmentation across the network, which matters when validators, RPC providers and indexers are trying to reproduce bugs against the same software baseline. Aptos still has more work to do around stability under load, but consolidating emergency fixes into a standard mainnet release is a necessary part of getting there. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.

This maintenance release helps standardize software versions across the network to enhance operational stability.

However, many traders remain skeptical of his market commentary, fueling the growth of the 'Inverse Cramer' trading trend. This strategy involves betting against his public recommendations, reflecting a clear disconnect between Cramer's personal investing philosophy and the market sentiment held by those who view his advice as a reliable indicator to trade in the opposite direction.
content_ta: Jim Cramer தனது முதலீட்டு உத்திகளில் ஒழுக்கத்தை கடைபிடிக்க வலியுறுத்தி வருகிறார். இருப்பினும், பல வர்த்தகர்கள் அவரது சந்தை கருத்துக்களை நம்ப மறுக்கின்றனர். இதனால் 'Inverse Cramer' என்ற வர்த்தக உத்தி பிரபலமடைந்து வருகிறது. Cramer பரிந்துரைக்கும் முதலீடுகளுக்கு எதிராக வர்த்தகம் செய்வதே இந்த உத்தியின் அடிப்படை. Cramer-இன் முதலீட்டு தத்துவத்திற்கும், அவரை ஒரு தவறான வழிகாட்டியாகக் கருதும் வர்த்தகர்களின் சந்தை உணர்விற்கும் இடையே உள்ள பெரிய இடைவெளியை இது காட்டுகிறது.

title: Sui Testnet v1.80.1 Expands Protocol 137 Features For Node Operators
summary: TL;DR Mysten Labs has released Sui testnet v1.80.1 using protocol version 137. The build includes updates across protocol logic, GraphQL, JSON-RPC and archival services. This is a testnet release and should not be described as a live Sui mainnet upgrade. Mysten Labs has published Sui testnet v1.80.1, giving developers and infrastructure operators an early look at protocol version 137 changes before they move further through the release process. The build touches several parts of the stack, from Move execution and RPC behavior to archival services. Protocol 137 Adds Several Developer-Facing Changes The release expands what can be tested around cryptographic verification, package visibility and data services. Among the changes, Ristretto255 range-proof verification becomes cheaper and supports larger batches, while the GraphQL subscription root moves into the production schema for operators that choose to enable it. Archival infrastructure also gets broader package-query support through the Bigtable-backed gRPC service. Those are not the kinds of changes most SUI holders will notice directly, but they matter to teams building wallets, indexers, trading systems and applications that depend on reliable network data. The update also changes some execution and gas-accounting behavior under protocol version 137. Testnet Means Exactly That The important caveat is deployment status. v1.80.1 is a testnet build. It should not be described as a completed Sui mainnet upgrade, and any performance or behavior observed in the test environment should not automatically be treated as live mainnet behavior. That is precisely why testnet releases exist. They give operators and developers time to identify compatibility issues before a version becomes part of the production network. For Sui, the release shows continued movement across the infrastructure stack without requiring users to take any immediate action. The more interesting question comes later: which of these protocol 137 changes graduate into mainnet, and how smoothly the ecosystem absorbs them when they do. Developers will also be watching compatibility rather than just new features. Changes to GraphQL, JSON-RPC and execution behavior can affect tooling even when no user-facing migration is required, so testnet gives indexers and application teams a place to catch assumptions before they become production incidents. Sui’s release cadence has been fast, which makes that staging process particularly important. A protocol version can look impressive in a changelog, but the real test is whether wallets, RPC services and applications continue working cleanly once the same code path reaches a busier environment. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.
content: Mysten Labs has released Sui testnet v1.80.1, introducing protocol version 137 to give node operators and developers an early look at new features. The update includes updates to Move execution, GraphQL, JSON-RPC, and archival services. It features cheaper Ristretto255 range-proof verification and broader package-query support. As this is strictly a testnet release, users and developers should test compatibility before any potential mainnet deployment.

title: Ondo Pushes USDY Deeper Into Solana DeFi
summary: TL;DR Ondo Finance says its USDY tokenized yield product is expanding across Solana DeFi venues. USDY is a yield-bearing tokenized note backed by short-term US Treasuries and bank deposits, not a conventional $1 stablecoin. The expansion builds on Ondo’s wider effort to make tokenized real-world assets usable inside DeFi rather than leaving them as passive holdings. Ondo Finance is pushing its tokenized US dollar yield product further into the Solana ecosystem, adding more places where USDY can be used rather than simply held. The move matters because tokenized real-world assets are increasingly being judged on utility, not just issuance volume. USDY Is A Yield Product, Not A Standard Stablecoin USDY is designed to represent exposure to short-term US Treasury and bank-deposit assets while accruing yield over time. That makes it structurally different from a conventional stablecoin such as USDC or USDT, which aims to stay close to a fixed $1 redemption value. As USDY integrates with Solana lending, liquidity and trading venues, holders can potentially use the asset as productive collateral or liquidity while still retaining exposure to the underlying yield profile. For Ondo, that is an important step. A tokenized Treasury product becomes much more useful when it can move through the same DeFi workflows as crypto-native collateral. Solana Is Becoming A Bigger RWA Distribution Layer Solana’s appeal for tokenized assets is straightforward: fast settlement, low transaction costs and an active DeFi ecosystem. Those characteristics make it easier for institutional-style assets to circulate rather than sitting in isolated wallets. The challenge is preserving the compliance and redemption structure of a regulated asset while making it composable enough to be useful onchain. Ondo has been steadily working on that bridge. The company’s recent product expansion has included tokenized equities and new institutional minting routes. Bringing USDY into more Solana applications extends the same strategy to yield-bearing dollar assets. The key distinction is that USDY should not be described as a bank-issued stablecoin. It is a tokenized note with a yield component. That difference affects how users should think about price behavior, eligibility and redemption — even as the asset becomes increasingly integrated with DeFi. For Solana applications, the attraction is that USDY brings a different type of collateral into the ecosystem. A lending market that accepts a yield-bearing Treasury-linked token can potentially offer users a lower-volatility building block alongside SOL and crypto-native stablecoins. That can broaden what DeFi protocols are able to construct, especially for users who want onchain liquidity without taking the full price risk of a volatile token. The harder part will be keeping liquidity deep enough that those integrations remain useful during redemptions and periods of market stress. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.

title: OKX Tightens European Institutional Trading Guidance Under MiCA
summary: TL;DR OKX has updated guidance for EEA institutional users around MiCA-aligned trading and stablecoin compliance. The changes relate to how eligible institutional accounts interact with supported fiat and stablecoin markets. The update is a compliance change, not a launch of a new token or trading product. OKX is continuing to adjust its European operating model around MiCA, with new guidance aimed at institutional users trading fiat and stablecoin pairs in the European Economic Area. The changes are less flashy than a new product launch, but they show how exchange operations are being reshaped as the EU’s crypto framework becomes part of everyday compliance. MiCA Is Moving From Policy To Product Rules For exchanges, regulation increasingly shows up inside account settings, eligibility rules and the list of assets available to different customer types. OKX’s updated guidance addresses institutional users and the conditions attached to MiCA-compliant stablecoin and fiat trading. That means firms using the exchange may face different thresholds or availability rules depending on jurisdiction, account classification and the regulatory status of the asset involved. The practical effect is that a market can remain technically available on the wider platform while access changes for particular European users. Exchange Compliance Is Becoming More Granular The European crypto market is no longer operating under one broad “allowed or not allowed” question. MiCA creates different obligations for issuers, exchanges and service providers, while stablecoins can carry their own regulatory requirements. That forces exchanges to make product-level decisions about what can be offered, to whom and under which legal entity. OKX’s update follows its recent European security initiatives, but the two issues are separate. This is about trading compliance rather than account protection. For institutional users, the lesson is straightforward: crypto exchanges are becoming more region-specific even when the interface looks global. The same asset pair can have different availability, risk controls or eligibility requirements depending on where the account sits. That complexity is likely to increase as MiCA enforcement matures and platforms standardize their European product stacks. For institutional desks, this kind of change is likely to become normal rather than exceptional. Exchange access used to be discussed mainly in terms of whether a token was listed. In Europe, the question increasingly includes which legal entity serves the customer, which stablecoin is being used, how the account is classified and whether a particular market is available under that combination. That may make large exchanges feel less uniform across borders, but it is also a sign that the industry is being forced to translate regulation into actual product controls instead of treating compliance as a disclosure page. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.
content: OKX has updated its European institutional trading guidance to align with the EU's MiCA regulatory framework. The changes affect EEA institutional users trading fiat and stablecoin pairs, emphasizing compliance, account classification, and asset availability rather than new product launches. This highlights how major crypto exchanges are increasingly tailoring their operations and region-specific rules to meet evolving European regulatory standards.

title: Experian Becomes First Personal Finance App Integrated with Google Gemini
summary:
Today, Experian, the global data and technology company, and Google announced a strategic collaboration that makes Experian the first personal finance app integrated with Google Gemini, expanding Experian's reach to one of the world's largest AI platforms and creating a new way for consumers to discover, access, and engage with Experian through conversational AI.
“Consumers increasingly expect to engage across the experiences and platforms that are part of their everyday lives,” said Jeff Softley, CEO of Experian North America.
“Our collaboration with Google delivers on that expectation, giving our existing members another way to engage with Experian while introducing us to consumers who may be discovering Experian for the first time. By bringing consumer-permissioned Experian credit insights into Gemini, we can help consumers better understand their credit and put their own information to work for them, in addition to the products, services, and experiences we power directly for our clients.”
Consumers in the United States will be able to connect with Experian in Gemini through a consumer-authorized experience and ask questions about their credit. Existing Experian members can connect their accounts, while consumers who discover Experian through Gemini can join Experian at no cost. They can also access their FICO® credit rating and key factors influencing it.
As AI assistants increasingly become part of how people navigate everyday decisions, Experian is extending trusted financial information into an emerging consumer channel while keeping consumers in control of whether their Experian information is connected and used. The collaboration also creates a new point of discovery for Experian, allowing consumers already using Gemini to connect with Experian, where they can access a broader range of financial products, services, and capabilities through the Experian app or website.
Turning Credit Information into Understanding
Consumers can ask Gemini questions about their Experian credit information and receive personalized responses designed to make that information easier to understand.
For example, a user can ask, “@Experian, what’s my credit rating?” and be prompted to connect directly with Experian to receive their credit rating within the Gemini experience. They can also ask about key factors influencing their credit, giving them additional context about where they stand and what may be affecting their credit profile.
Rather than simply viewing static information, consumers can ask questions in a conversational experience that combines Experian’s trusted credit data with Gemini’s AI capabilities to help make credit information easier to understand.
Consumers who want to view their FICO® Score 8 will continue to access it directly through the Experian website or app, where they can access a broader range of products, services, and capabilities designed to help them manage their financial lives and find more ways to save time and money.
How It Works
Connecting to Google Gemini’s Connect App ecosystem is designed to be simple, secure, and consumer controlled.
Users sign in to their Google account and open Gemini. From the Personal Intelligence menu, they can navigate to Connected Apps, select Experian, and choose to link and authorize access to their Experian account. Users also have the ability to tag “@Experian” to connect with the Experian app within a chat when asking a credit-related question.
Existing Experian members can authorize access to their Experian account, while consumers who are new to Experian can join at no cost and establish an Experian membership.
After securely authenticating, consumers can ask Gemini questions about their Experian credit information, including their FICO® credit rating and the key factors influencing it. Consumers can manage their connected app settings through Google’s Personal Intelligence settings at any time.
Expanding How Consumers Discover and Access Experian
The collaboration builds on Experian’s long track record of consumer innovation and advances its strategy of giving consumers more ways to engage where they choose.
As consumers increasingly use AI-powered assistants alongside apps, websites, and other digital experiences, Experian is expanding the ways consumers can access and engage with trusted financial information. The Gemini integration gives Experian another way to reach consumers, both existing members and people discovering Experian for the first time, through an AI platform that is increasingly part of consumers' everyday lives.
Gemini becomes another channel in Experian's broader consumer ecosystem, complementing the products and services it provides directly and the experiences it powers for financial institutions and other clients. Together, these experiences give consumers more ways to access Experian information, insights, and capabilities throughout their financial lives.
The companies also plan to build on the collaboration over time, expanding the Experian capabilities consumers can access through Gemini—such as subscription cancellation, which could help consumers save on unwanted subscriptions they currently pay for.

title: Trade Tech Solutions Enters New Phase of Growth, 2 Million Users Strong
summary:
With more than 2 million users, over 1 million active accounts each month, more than 200 million dollars in client revenues processed through its infrastructure each year and 100 million dollars in payouts processed to date, Trade Tech Solutions is consolidating its position as the technology layer beneath a large share of the prop and broker market.
The proprietary trading industry has grown quickly, and the technology underneath it has had to grow with it. Prop firms have moved well beyond forex and CFDs, brokers are launching their own challenge-based products, and traders now judge a firm as much on execution, platform stability and payout reliability as on its marketing. Behind that shift is a quieter question for operators: whether their infrastructure can keep pace.
Trade Tech Solutions has reached a point that answers it in scale. The company has surpassed 2 million users, the individual traders holding accounts with the firms running on its technology, and has processed more than 100 million dollars in payouts to date. Its infrastructure also handles over 1 million active accounts every month and more than 200 million dollars in client revenues each year, processed on behalf of the 85+ prop firms it supports across 180+ regions, spanning forex, CFDs, futures, cryptocurrencies, sports and prediction markets.
The milestone marks a change in what the company is. Trade Tech Solutions has grown from a prop firm technology vendor into the operating backbone for a substantial part of the market, with payments, risk, compliance, CRM and back-office workflows connected in one system rather than stitched together from separate tools.
One connected system, not a stack of parts
The trading industry's technology requirements have become more demanding as the products themselves have diversified. Firms now need infrastructure that supports multiple asset classes, connects with established trading platforms, processes payments across many regions and gives operators clear visibility into trader activity, risk exposure and account performance, all at once.
Trade Tech Solutions is built to deliver those functions through a single operating environment rather than a collection of integrations. The platform supports more than 20 trading platforms, including MT4, MT5, cTrader, Match-Trader, NinjaTrader and Tradovate, and can support prediction markets trading through Match-Trader integration, allowing firms to introduce event-based products alongside their existing offerings.
"Trading businesses are no longer working within one clearly defined product category," said Stefano M., Partnership Manager at Trade Tech Solutions. "Operators want infrastructure that can support different trading models while keeping technology, risk management, payments and customer operations connected. That flexibility is becoming central to how firms plan for growth."
Built for brokers as well as prop firms
While much of the prop sector's attention has focused on challenge providers, the same infrastructure requirements now apply to brokers building their own prop-style offerings. Trade Tech Solutions positions its technology for both, giving established brokers a route into challenge-based products without assembling a separate technology stack to run them.
For new entrants, the time required to launch a trading business affects both operating costs and the ability to act on market opportunities. For established firms, replacing legacy infrastructure raises concerns about downtime, data fragmentation and disruption to existing traders. Trade Tech Solutions offers migration in as little as 48 hours and can have new firms live in as little as seven days, depending on scope, which lowers both barriers at once.
The platform pairs that speed with breadth: customer management, trader dashboards, real-time risk monitoring, checkout, KYC and AML integrations, and back-office operations, all handled within the same environment. Firms can introduce new products without running a separate system for each stage of the customer and trading lifecycle.
Payments and payouts across 180+ regions
Access to funds is one of the clearest markers of a well-run prop operation and one of the most common sources of trader frustration when it goes wrong. Trade Tech Solutions' infrastructure connects to more than 80 payment processors across 180+ regions, giving operators flexibility in how they handle deposits and payout requests and reducing dependence on any single provider.
Payouts are semi-automated and include a manual approval step, an additional control before funds are released. Traders can track the relevant rules, limits and payout requests through a real-time dashboard, so the process stays visible on both sides.
Visibility as the foundation of trust
As the sector has matured, traders have grown more attentive to the operational detail behind the firms they choose. Execution quality, platform stability, account visibility and payout processes all shape whether a firm earns their confidence.
Trade Tech Solutions gives firms the tools to display challenge rules, account performance, risk exposure and relevant trading information through a centralised dashboard. All trading accounts supported through these programmes are simulated, with firms managing the related rules and workflows through the platform. For operators, the same visibility supports more consistent risk management and makes it easier to identify irregularities across accounts and trading activity.
"Technology has to serve both sides of the trading relationship," Stefano M. added. "Firms need visibility across their operations, and traders need clear information about their accounts, rules and requests. Connecting those functions creates a more transparent environment for everyone involved."
Proven across the sector
Trade Tech Solutions' technology is currently used by 85+ prop firms, including Goat Funded Trader and Goat Funded Futures. The two brands show how a single infrastructure can support different trading programmes while keeping account management, trading platforms, risk controls and payouts connected across both.
With more than 2 million users across its network, over 1 million active accounts each month, more than 200 million dollars in client revenues processed through its infrastructure each year and 100 million dollars in payouts processed to date, Trade Tech Solutions has moved from being one vendor among many into an established infrastructure layer for the trading industry. Its growth reflects a broader shift among brokers and prop firms towards integrated technology that supports multiple products, regional requirements and operational processes without relying on fragmented systems.

title: Equifax Launches Two New Intelligence Solutions to Help Businesses Mitigate Automated Fraud
summary:
Equifax® is expanding its fraud prevention capabilities with the launch of two new intelligence solutions: Signal Score for Email and Signal Score for Device. The new Signal Scores are designed to help e-commerce retailers, financial institutions and telecommunication companies protect their digital platforms - such as online checkout lanes, new account sign-up portals and mobile ordering apps - against sophisticated fraud networks and automated threats.
 

"Businesses can no longer rely on static snapshots of customers to stop fraud," said Ajay Guru, Senior Vice President and General Manager, Identity & Fraud Services at Equifax. "Leveraging our unique differentiated data, these new solutions are designed to deliver a trust score in real time, giving our customers a better view of a user and helping them to mitigate fraud more quickly."
 
As digital fraud grows increasingly complex, traditional checks are no longer enough to deter automated threats because they cannot see behind the digital blind spots created by VPNs and emulators. Organizations need real-time intelligence to instantly detect sophisticated tactics like script-driven account farming, location spoofing and synthetic identity fraud before they impact the business.
 
The new Signal Score for Email and Signal Score for Device solutions are designed to use proprietary Equifax data to evaluate risk instantly at the start of a transaction, keeping the experience simple and secure for legitimate consumers. Unlike traditional industry tools that rely on static global networks or lagging database files, the solutions leverage Equifax non-public, first-party sourced data and unique identity linkage to instantly connect digital session behaviors with trusted, real-world consumer profiles.
 
Translating Email and Device Signals into Immediate, Actionable Trust Scores
 


Signal Score for Email: Evaluates an email address in real time. It assesses the age of the account, its history and its risk level to determine if the digital identifier is trustworthy.
Signal Score for Device: Analyzes the computer or phone used in a transaction. It connects device details, location data and network information to validate the electronic instrument to the user.
 
The two new Signal Scores connect directly to a company's existing fraud prevention or case management systems through Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), making it easy for businesses to enhance current fraud stacks. Companies can use both tools together or pick one to fill a specific data intelligence gap. Designed specifically for internal fraud and risk teams, the new tools deliver faster, actionable data at critical entry points like new account sign-ups and checkouts.
 

"Fraud can happen at any step of an online interaction," added Guru. "Our unique data and tools give companies what they need to stop criminals without adding slow, extra steps for valid customers."
 
By spotting high-risk users early, companies can reduce manual review costs while providing a faster experience for honest consumers.
 
In addition to the new Signal Scores, Equifax offers Consumer Insights, which uses basic information to help businesses assess fraud risk and payment ability and help compliance and security teams prevent account takeovers.

title: EU financial watchdogs warn quantum computing poses imminent threat to blockchain encryption
summary: The warning brings renewed urgency to the debate over how bitcoin should deal with legacy addresses whose public keys are already exposed onchain.

title: Bitget Wallet Says Global Downloads Have Passed 40 Million
summary: TL;DR Bitget says cumulative downloads of Bitget Wallet have surpassed 40 million worldwide. The figure refers to total app downloads, not monthly active users or active trading accounts. The milestone reflects distribution growth as the wallet adds more trading and tokenized-asset features. Bitget says its self-custody wallet has crossed 40 million cumulative downloads, giving the company another headline growth number as it tries to expand beyond the traditional exchange model. The figure is notable, but it needs to be read correctly. Forty Million Downloads Is Not Forty Million Active Users App-download milestones are useful for measuring distribution. They are not the same thing as monthly active users, funded wallets or people who transact every day. A single user can also download an app on more than one device or reinstall it over time. So the 40 million figure should be understood as cumulative distribution rather than a direct measure of current engagement. Even with that caveat, scale matters for a wallet business. A large installed base gives Bitget more room to distribute swaps, tokenized-stock products, DeFi access and other financial services directly through the wallet interface. Wallets Are Becoming Full Trading Platforms The line between an exchange app and a self-custody wallet keeps getting thinner. Modern wallets increasingly include integrated trading, token discovery, yield products, cross-chain transfers and access to tokenized traditional assets. That makes user distribution strategically important. If a wallet can turn a large download base into repeat activity, it becomes a direct gateway to onchain financial products rather than simply a place to store keys. Bitget’s milestone does not tell us how many of those 40 million downloads are active today. It does show the size of the top of the funnel. The next useful metrics would be active wallets, transaction frequency and the share of users adopting the newer financial products inside the app. For now, the company can point to 40 million cumulative downloads as evidence that its wallet has reached a meaningfully global audience. The milestone also gives Bitget a useful benchmark against which future engagement can be judged. If the wallet keeps growing but trading, swaps and onchain activity do not rise with it, downloads will matter less. If newer features convert those installs into repeat use, the distribution advantage becomes much more valuable. Wallets are one of the few crypto products that can sit between users and multiple chains at once, so the companies that win distribution may eventually have more influence over where liquidity, trades and tokenized assets are routed than the headline download number suggests today. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.
content: Bitget Wallet has announced that its global cumulative downloads have surpassed 40 million worldwide. While this figure represents total app installations rather than active daily users, the milestone highlights the self-custody wallet's growing distribution. As modern wallets expand to include integrated trading and financial services, the large installed base provides Bitget with a significant foundation to drive further onchain engagement and user activity.

Bloomsbury, Chelsea மற்றும் Soho ஆகிய பகுதிகளில் உள்ள மூன்று Kiss the Hippo கஃபேக்களில் வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் இப்போது தங்கள் முக அடையாளத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி காபி வாங்கலாம். இயற்பியல் அட்டைகள் அல்லது ஸ்மார்ட்போன்களைப் பயன்படுத்தாமல், வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் தங்கள் வாங்குதல்களை விரைவாக முடிக்க இந்த சோதனை முயற்சி உதவுகிறது.

content_ta: Emerging markets-களில் payment services வழங்குவதில் நிபுணத்துவம் பெற்ற உலகளாவிய technology நிறுவனமான EBANX, தனது வருடாந்திர Payments Summit-ல் Pakistan-கிற்கு தனது சேவையை விரிவுபடுத்துவதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. title: TransUnion FCA FOI Finds High Proportion of Individuals Scammed Twice Through Recovery Rooms
summary:
A Freedom of Information (FOI) request submitted to the FCA by TransUnion found that almost one in five (17%) of all scams reported in 2025 mentioned a form of recovery room scam. This percentage remains stubbornly high, underlining how many people who have already been targeted by a scam continue to be targeted again.
 
Recovery room scams, where criminals falsely promise to help recover money lost to a previous scam in exchange for an upfront fee, continue to cause significant harm. As many as 70% of these recovery room scams were associated with cryptocurrencies in 2025, with cryptocurrency scams themselves (14%) the third most reported scam type in that year, after FCA impersonation (26%) and recovery room scams (17%).
 
Madhu Kejriwal, chief executive officer of TransUnion UK and Europe said: “Unfortunately, there is a whole market of scams that target people who have already been defrauded. Once you’ve been a victim, fraudsters can seize the opportunity to target you a second time, and in a lot of cases, this can be effective because they hold verified information on the individual from the original scam.
 
“In the case of cryptocurrency scams, there is often no obvious route to recover lost funds, unlike traditional banking fraud, where customers can seek assistance from their bank. This naturally opens up an opportunity for criminals to pose as recovery agents.”
 
TransUnion's Tips for Protecting Against Fraud
 
Pause before you pay. Fraudsters rely on urgency. Any request to transfer money, share a one-time passcode, or act "immediately" to avoid a penalty should be treated as a red flag, whatever channel it comes through. 
 
Verify independently. If you receive a call, email or message claiming to be from your bank, a government body or a company you deal with, contact them directly using a number or website you already trust, never one provided in the message itself. When contacting your bank you can use the 159 service, which provides direct connection to official bank contact numbers. If you have received an email which you’re not quite sure about, forward it to the Suspicious Email Reporting Service (SERS): report@phishing.gov.uk   
 
Be sceptical of unexpected contact, even if it looks or sounds convincing. Always be cautious of an out of the blue contact offering to help recover money. Ask how the caller has the information. Reports of fraud can only be exchanged between law enforcement agencies and cannot be shared with private businesses that operate ‘so called’ recovery room services. Most phone providers are part of an initiative that allows customers to report suspicious text messages for free by forwarding them to 7726. 
 
Protect personal information. Fraudsters increasingly use small pieces of publicly available data to build convincing, personalised scams. Limiting what is shared on social media and being cautious about who you share personal details with can reduce exposure. 
 
Use multi-factor authentication wherever it's offered, particularly for banking, email, and any account linked to payments, as this remains one of the most effective barriers against account takeover.        
 
Report suspected fraud promptly, both to your bank and to Report Fraud. Early reporting improves the chance of recovering losses and helps build the intelligence picture used to stop similar scams reaching others. 
 
For businesses, review fraud controls regularly, particularly around payment authorisation and identity verification, given how quickly criminal tactics are evolving alongside the technology. 
 
Understand tools available: Use FCA firm checker to check a financial firm is authorised and has regulatory permissions to provide the relevant service.
NoYesSecurity24 Sep, 2026
content: A Freedom of Information request found that nearly one in five scams reported in 2025 involved recovery room scams, where fraudsters charge upfront fees to help victims recover lost funds. TransUnion noted that cryptocurrency scams are frequently linked to these schemes, as victims often lack traditional bank protections. Experts advise consumers to independently verify communications and remain highly sceptical of unexpected offers promising fund recovery.
content_ta: 2025-ல் பதிவான மோசடிகளில் ஐந்தில் ஒன்று recovery room மோசடிகளுடன் தொடர்புடையது என்று Freedom of Information தகவல் கோரிக்கை மூலம் தெரியவந்துள்ளது. இழந்த பணத்தை மீட்டுத் தருவதாகக் கூறி மோசடி செய்பவர்கள் முன்கூட்டியே கட்டணம் வசூலிக்கின்றனர். வழக்கமான வங்கிப் பாதுகாப்பு இல்லாததால் cryptocurrency மோசடிகள் இதுபோன்ற திட்டங்களுடன் அடிக்கடி இணைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளதாக TransUnion குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளது. தகவல் தொடர்புகளைச் சரிபார்த்து, எதிர்பாராத பண மீட்பு சலுகைகள் குறித்து எச்சரிக்கையுடன் இருக்குமாறு நிபுணர்கள் அறிவுறுத்துகின்றனர்.

title: Brooklyn man sent to prison for 12 years for stealing $16M in a Coinbase phishing scheme
summary: The fraudster managed to scam about 100 people across the United States, convincing them of transferring funds to him, claiming their accounts had been hacked.
content: A Brooklyn man has been sentenced to 12 years in prison for orchestrating a phishing scheme targeting Coinbase users. The fraudster stole approximately $16 million by tricking around 100 victims across the United States into transferring funds under the false claim that their accounts had been compromised.
content_ta: Coinbase பயனர்களை இலக்காகக் கொண்டு ஃபிஷிங் மோசடியில் ஈடுபட்ட ப்ரூக்ளினைச் சேர்ந்த நபருக்கு 12 ஆண்டுகள் சிறை தண்டனை விதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. பாதிக்கப்பட்டவர்களின் கணக்குகள் ஹேக் செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளதாகக் கூறி அமெரிக்கா முழுவதும் சுமார் 100 பேரை ஏமாற்றி தோராயமாக $16 மில்லியன் திருடப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Litecoin token has its moment as network activity booms
summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 24, 2026
content: Litecoin experienced a significant surge in attention as network activity on its blockchain experienced a major boom. The uptick in user engagement and transactions highlights renewed interest in the digital asset, setting the stage for market developments looking ahead.
content_ta: Litecoin நெட்வொர்க் செயல்பாடு கணிசமாக அதிகரித்துள்ளதால், அதன் டோக்கன் சந்தையில் பெரும் கவனத்தைப் பெற்றுள்ளது. பிளாக்சைன் நெட்வொர்க்கில் பயனர்களின் ஈடுபாடும் பரிவர்த்தனைகளும் உயர்ந்திருப்பது இந்த டிஜிட்டல் சொத்தின் மீதான ஆர்வத்தை மீண்டும் தூண்டியுள்ளது.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin continues lower as bond yields take center stage
summary: U.S. bond yields are little changed early Thursday after yesterday's surge higher sent risk markets sharply lower.
content: Bitcoin continued its downward trend as rising bond yields took center stage in global financial markets. U.S. bond yields remained steady early Thursday following a significant surge in the previous session, which had triggered sharp declines across various risk-sensitive markets.
content_ta: பண்டிங் சந்தைகளில் பாண்ட் ஈல்டு (bond yields) உயர்ந்ததன் காரணமாக Bitcoin விலை தொடர்ந்து சரிவை சந்தித்து வருகிறது. கடந்த அமர்வில் ஏற்பட்ட திடீர் உயர்வுக்குப் பிறகு, வியாழக்கிழமை தொடக்கத்தில் U.S. பாண்ட் ஈல்டு பெரிதாக மாறாமல் நிலையாக இருந்தது, இது ரிஸ்க் சந்தைகளில் பெரும் சரிவை ஏற்படுத்தியது.

title: Bitcoin slides to $83,300 as bond yields hit highest level since 2007
summary: The 10-year Treasury yield reached its highest since 2007, sending U.S. stocks and crypto lower before Asian and European traders bought the dip.
content: Bitcoin fell to $83,300 after the 10-year Treasury yield reached its highest level since 2007. The surging bond yields put downward pressure on U.S. stocks and the broader cryptocurrency market. However, market losses were later cushioned as Asian and European traders stepped in to buy the dip.
content_ta: 10-ஆண்டு Treasury yield 2007-க்குப் பிறகு இல்லாத அளவுக்கு உயர்ந்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து, Bitcoin விலை $83,300 ஆகக் குறைந்தது. இந்தப் பத்திர வருமான உயர்வு U.S. stocks மற்றும் கிரிப்டோ சந்தையில் சரிவை ஏற்படுத்தியது. இருப்பினும், ஆசிய மற்றும் ஐரோப்பிய வர்த்தகர்கள் விலைக் குறைவைப் பயன்படுத்திக் பங்குகளை வாங்கியதால் சந்தை மீண்டது.

title: Traders price in 4 Fed rate hikes by June 2027 as bitcoin slides below $83,000
summary: The four-hike path is the most likely outcome, while rising bond yields and a stronger dollar weigh on bitcoin and gold.
content: Traders are now pricing in four Federal Reserve rate hikes by June 2027. This expectation comes as bitcoin prices slide below $83,000. The projected rate path represents a significant market outcome. Meanwhile, rising bond yields and a stronger US dollar continue to weigh heavily on traditional safe-haven assets like gold as well as cryptocurrencies.
content_ta: ஜூன் 2027க்குள் 4 முறை ஃபெடரல் ரிசர்வ் வட்டி விகிதங்களை உயர்த்தக்கூடும் என வர்த்தகர்கள் கணிக்கின்றனர். பிட்காயின் விலை 83,000 டۆலருக்கும் கீழே சரிந்ததை அடுத்து இந்த எதிர்பார்ப்பு எழுந்துள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், உயர்ந்து வரும் பாண்ட் ஈவுத்தொகை மற்றும் வலுவான டாலர் ஆகியவை தங்கம் மற்றும் பிட்காயின் போன்ற சொத்துகளின் விலையில் அழுத்தத்தை ஏற்படுத்துகின்றன.

title: Era of pure crypto exchanges is ending, Bybit CEO says
summary: Bybit’s global campaign positions it as a broader financial platform, though its stock, gold and forex derivatives were already available.
content: The era of pure cryptocurrency exchanges is coming to an end, according to the CEO of Bybit. The exchange has launched a global campaign to rebrand itself as a broader financial platform. Despite this new positioning, the platform already offered various traditional financial instruments, including stock, gold, and forex derivatives, to its global user base.
content_ta: தூய கிரிப்டோகரன்சி எக்ஸ்சேஞ்ச்களின் காலம் முடிவுக்கு வந்து கொண்டிருப்பதாக Bybit-ன் CEO தெரிவித்துள்ளார். இந்த எக்ஸ்சேஞ்ச் தன்னை ஒரு பரந்த நிதி தளமாக நிலைநிறுத்திக் கொள்ள உலகளாவிய பிரச்சாரத்தைத் தொடங்கியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய நிலைநிறுத்தலுக்கு முன்பே, இந்த தளம் ஸ்டாக், தங்கம் மற்றும் ஃபாரெக்ஸ் டெரிவேடிவ்கள் உள்ளிட்ட பல்வேறு பாரம்பரிய நிதி கருவிகளை தனது பயனர்களுக்கு வழங்கி வந்தது.

title: EU banking watchdog calls for crypto lending rules under MiCA
summary: The EBA outlined potential rules for crypto lending and firms providing access to DeFi protocols as part of the European Commission’s MiCA review.
content: The European Banking Authority has called for new regulatory guidelines regarding crypto lending and decentralized finance protocols. As part of the European Commission's ongoing MiCA review, the financial watchdog outlined potential rules aimed at overseeing firms that provide access to DeFi activities, ensuring greater oversight and consumer protection within the digital asset sector.
content_ta: Crypto lending மற்றும் DeFi protocols தொடர்பான புதிய ஒழுங்குமுறை வழிகாட்டுதல்களை European Banking Authority கோரியுள்ளது. European Commission-ன் MiCA review-ன் ஒரு பகுதியாக, digital asset துறையில் அதிகப்படியான கண்காணிப்பு மற்றும் நுகர்வோர் பாதுகாப்பை உறுதி செய்வதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டு இந்த potential rules வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளன.

title: Q-Day Could Arrive Before Quantum Computers Are Commercially Useful, EU Warns
summary:
The EU's proactive stance on post-quantum cryptography highlights urgent global cybersecurity challenges, emphasizing the need for rapid adaptation.
The post EU warns Q-Day could arrive before quantum computers are commercially viable appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The European Union has warned that Q-Day, the moment when quantum computers could break current encryption methods, might arrive before quantum technology becomes commercially useful. This proactive stance highlights urgent global cybersecurity challenges and emphasizes the critical need for rapid adaptation and post-quantum cryptography to secure sensitive data against future threats.
content_ta: தற்போதைய என்கிரிப்ஷன் முறைகளை குவாண்டம் கம்ப்யூட்டர்கள் முறியடிக்கும் Q-Day ஆனது, குவாண்டம் தொழில்நுட்பம் வணிக ரீதியாகப் பயன்பாட்டுக்கு வருவதற்கு முன்பே வரக்கூடும் என்று EU எச்சரித்துள்ளது. இந்த முன்கூட்டிய எச்சரிக்கையானது உலகளாவிய சைபர் பாதுகாப்பு சவால்களை எடுத்துக்காட்டுவதுடன், எதிர்கால அச்சுறுத்தல்களிலிருந்து பாதுகாப்பான தரவுகளைப் பாதுகாக்க போஸ்ட்-குவாண்டம் கிரிப்டோகிராஃபி முறைகளுக்கு விரைவாக மாறுவதன் அவசியத்தையும் வலியுறுத்துகிறது.

title: HIFI raises $37 million Series A to expand tokenized capital markets infrastructure
summary: HIFI raised $37 million in Series A funding led by Left Lane Capital to scale tokenized settlement infrastructure.
content: HIFI has successfully raised $37 million in a Series A funding round to expand its tokenized capital markets infrastructure. The investment was led by Left Lane Capital and aims to scale the company's tokenized settlement infrastructure, supporting the growth of digital asset markets.
content_ta: டோக்கனைஸ் செய்யப்பட்ட கேபிடல் மார்க்கெட்ஸ் இன்ஃப்ராஸ்ட்ரக்சரை விரிவுபடுத்துவதற்காக HIFI நிறுவனம் Series A முதலீட்டு சுற்றில் 37 மில்லியன் டாலர்களை வெற்றிகரமாக திரட்டியுள்ளது. Left Lane Capital தலைமையில் நடைபெற்ற இந்த முதலீட்டு திரட்டல், நிறுவனத்தின் டோக்கனைஸ் செய்யப்பட்ட செட்டில்மென்ட் இன்ஃப்ராஸ்ட்ரக்சரை மேம்படுத்துவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: IBM connects Digital Asset Haven to Swift blockchain ledger for tokenized deposit transactions
summary: IBM Digital Asset Haven clients can now connect to Swift's shared ledger and instruct tokenized deposit transactions.
content: IBM has connected its Digital Asset Haven to the Swift blockchain ledger, enabling clients to instruct tokenized deposit transactions securely. This integration bridges traditional financial messaging infrastructure with emerging distributed ledger technology, allowing institutional users to streamline and manage tokenized assets efficiently through an established and trusted global network.
content_ta: IBM தனது Digital Asset Haven தளத்தை Swift blockchain ledger உடன் இணைத்துள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் tokenized deposit பரிவர்த்தனைகளை மேற்கொள்ள முடியும். இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பு பாரம்பரிய நிதி அமைப்புகளையும் புதிய புவியியல் தொழில்நுட்பத்தையும் இணைத்து, நிறுவன பயனர்களுக்கு பாதுகாப்பான மற்றும் திறமையான சேவையை வழங்குகிறது.

title: Why Zcash soared to $1,600 as Europe unlocks new ETP access
summary:
21Shares listed ZCASH in Paris and Amsterdam as ZEC briefly topped $1,600 and ZODL reported elevated privacy use.
The post Why Zcash soared to $1,600 as Europe unlocks new ETP access appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Zcash experienced a significant price surge, briefly topping $1,600, following new European Exchange Traded Product access. Issuer 21Shares expanded its crypto ETP offerings by listing Zcash products on exchanges in Paris and Amsterdam, boosting visibility and market participation. Additionally, reports highlighted elevated usage of privacy features surrounding the asset, contributing to the recent upward momentum across the market.
content_ta: ஐரோப்பாவில் புதிய ETP அணுக்கம் கிடைத்ததை அடுத்து Zcash விலை உயர்ந்து $1,600-ஐத் தொட்டது. பாரிஸ் மற்றும் ஆம்ஸ்டர்டாம் பங்குச் சந்தைகளில் 21Shares நிறுவனம் புதிய Zcash தயாரிப்புகளைப் பட்டியலிட்டது. இது சந்தை ஈடுபாட்டை அதிகரித்ததுடன், இந்த கிரிப்டோ சொத்தின் தனியுரிமை அம்சங்களின் பயன்பாடு உயர்ந்திருப்பதாகவும் அறிக்கைகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன.

title: Who is Ronald Spektor? New York Coinbase Scam Mastermind That Stole $15.9M
summary:
A Coinbase scam stole roughly $15.944 million from about 100 users before Ronald Spektor was sentenced to four to 12 years in prison in New York.
The post Who is Ronald Spektor? New York Coinbase Scam Mastermind That Stole $15.9M appeared first on Cryptonews.
content: Ronald Spektor has been sentenced to four to 12 years in prison in New York as the mastermind behind a major Coinbase scam. The fraudulent scheme targeted approximately 100 users and successfully stole roughly $15.9 million in funds before law enforcement intervened and brought the perpetrator to justice.
content_ta: New York-ல் நடைபெற்ற ஒரு பெரிய Coinbase மோசடி வழக்கில் மூளையாகச் செயல்பட்ட Ronald Spektor-க்கு நான்கு முதல் 12 ஆண்டுகள் சிறை தண்டனை விதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த மோசடி மூலம் சுமார் 100 பயனர்களிடமிருந்து தோராயமாக $15.9 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான தொகை திருடப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Optimism Says Superchain TVL Has Crossed $14 Billion
summary: TL;DR Optimism says aggregate TVL across the Superchain has moved above $14 billion. The figure combines multiple OP Stack networks rather than representing OP Mainnet alone. The milestone highlights the growing economic footprint of Base, World Chain and other interconnected OP Stack chains. Optimism’s Superchain has crossed a reported $14 billion in aggregate total value locked, giving the OP Stack another way to measure how far the ecosystem has expanded beyond a single Layer 2. The number combines several networks built around Optimism’s shared technology rather than measuring OP Mainnet on its own. The Superchain Is Bigger Than Optimism Mainnet That distinction matters. The broader Superchain includes networks such as Base, World Chain and other OP Stack deployments that operate their own applications and user bases while sharing parts of the same technical roadmap. Adding their TVL together creates a view of the capital sitting across the wider ecosystem. It does not mean $14 billion is locked directly on OP Mainnet. That makes the metric useful for understanding platform reach, but less useful if it is compared directly with the TVL of a single chain. Interoperability Is The Bigger Bet Optimism’s long-term strategy is not simply to make one rollup larger. It is to make many OP Stack chains behave more like parts of one interoperable system. Upcoming work around shared proofs, messaging and cross-chain state is aimed at reducing the friction between those networks. If that succeeds, aggregate metrics such as Superchain TVL may become more meaningful because capital could move more naturally across the ecosystem. For now, the $14 billion figure shows scale rather than seamless interoperability. Users still experience separate chains, bridges and application environments. But the economic footprint is already large enough that Optimism can credibly talk about an ecosystem of chains instead of a single Layer 2. The next stage is making that ecosystem feel as connected in practice as it looks on an aggregate dashboard. For developers choosing where to deploy, the Superchain thesis also changes the decision from picking a single Layer 2 to joining a broader technical family. Shared tooling and standards can lower development costs, while future interoperability could make users less sensitive to which OP Stack chain an application actually lives on. That is the strategic promise behind the aggregate TVL figure. The ecosystem has already accumulated meaningful capital across separate chains; Optimism now has to prove that those chains can become more connected without recreating the security and liquidity fragmentation that rollups were supposed to reduce. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.
content: Optimism announced that the aggregate total value locked across its Superchain has surpassed $14 billion. This combined figure includes multiple OP Stack networks such as Base and World Chain, highlighting the expanding economic footprint and platform reach of the broader ecosystem beyond just the OP Mainnet.
content_ta: Optimism நிறுவனத்தின் Superchain சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பின் மொத்த பூட்டப்பட்ட மதிப்பு (TVL) $14 பில்லியனைக் கடந்துள்ளதாக அறிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. Base மற்றும் World Chain உள்ளிட்ட பல OP Stack நெட்வொர்க்குகளின் கூட்டுத் தொகையான இந்த மதிப்பு, OP Mainnet-ஐ தாண்டி இந்த சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பின் பரந்த வளர்ச்சியை எடுத்துரைக்கிறது.

title: Base Activity Climbs To 7.5 Million Transactions In A Day
summary: TL;DR Base network activity reached roughly 7.5 million transactions over a single day in the validated September 22 data. The count includes all recorded transactions, including low-value and automated activity. High transaction count is a usage metric, not proof of equivalent economic value. Base has pushed daily transaction activity to roughly 7.5 million, adding another scale milestone for Coinbase’s Ethereum Layer 2 ecosystem. The number is eye-catching, but the more interesting question is what it says about the type of activity happening on the network. Cheap Transactions Change What Users Put Onchain Layer 2 networks make it economical to record interactions that would be too expensive to justify on Ethereum mainnet. That can include social actions, wallet automation, small trades, game events and application-level transactions that may carry very little individual dollar value. As a result, a transaction record can reflect genuine adoption while also including a large amount of automated or micro-transaction activity. That distinction is important when comparing Base with networks where each transaction is more expensive and therefore tends to represent a different mix of use cases. Base Keeps Expanding Beyond Simple DeFi The network’s growth has increasingly come from consumer-facing apps, smart wallets and social or commerce products alongside conventional DeFi. That broader application mix can generate far more transactions than a chain built mainly around high-value financial settlement. For Coinbase, Base also creates a distribution layer that sits underneath its wider product ecosystem. Users can move from exchange accounts into onchain applications without leaving the company’s broader orbit. A 7.5 million transaction day does not tell us how many unique humans were active or how much economic value moved. It does show that Base is handling activity at a scale where throughput and infrastructure efficiency matter. The next question is whether that usage persists when incentives or individual applications cool down. Daily transaction records are easy to celebrate. Sustained user retention is the harder metric. Base also benefits from a distribution advantage that most Layer 2 networks do not have: a direct connection to one of the largest consumer crypto platforms. That does not guarantee that exchange users become onchain users, but it lowers the friction when Coinbase chooses to surface Base-native experiences. The harder challenge is making activity sticky once users arrive. A chain can generate millions of daily interactions around one popular application and still see usage fall sharply later. The 7.5 million figure is therefore impressive, but retention and economic value per user will tell the more durable story. This article was written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.
content: Coinbase's Ethereum Layer 2 network, Base, reached approximately 7.5 million transactions in a single day, according to September 22 data. This milestone highlights the network's growing scale, driven by consumer applications, smart wallets, and low-cost transactions. However, experts note that high transaction counts reflect usage rather than guaranteed economic value, with long-term user retention remaining a key challenge for the platform.
content_ta: Coinbase-ன் Ethereum Layer 2 நெட்வொர்க்கான Base, செப்டம்பர் 22 நிலவரப்படி ஒரே நாளில் சுமார் 7.5 மில்லியன் பரிவர்த்தனைகளைக் கடந்துள்ளது. நுகர்வோர் பயன்பாடுகள், ஸ்மார்ட் வாலட்டுகள் மற்றும் குறைந்த செலவிலான பரிவர்த்தனைகள் மூலம் இந்த மைல்கல் எட்டப்பட்டுள்ளது. எனினும், அதிக பரிவர்த்தனை எண்ணிக்கை என்பது பயன்பாட்டைக் குறிக்கிறதே தவிர பொருளாதார மதிப்பை உறுதிப்படுத்தாது என்றும், பயனர்களை தொடர்ந்து தக்கவைப்பதே முக்கிய சவால் என்றும் நிபுணர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: TRON Surpasses $30T in Total Transaction Volume as it Secures its Place as Leading Chain for Stablecoins
summary: Geneva, Switzerland, September 24, 2026 — TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), today announced that total transaction volume settled on the TRON blockchain has surpassed $30 trillion. A milestone driven by the network’s high throughput, low costs, and deep liquidity, making TRON the settlement layer of choice for stablecoin transfers, payments, and digital asset activity worldwide.   TRON has now recorded more than 405 million total user accounts, over 15 billion total transactions, more than $28 billion in total value locked (TVL) and currently carries more than $94 billion in circulating USDT, the largest supply of any blockchain. According to Token Terminal, TRON leads all networks in USDT transfer volume year to date, with approximately $6 trillion, averaging $25 billion in daily transfer volume. That momentum is also extending into consumer payments. According to CoinDesk Research, crypto payment card volumes grew from $2 billion in the first quarter of 2026 to $2.4 billion in the second, with TRON’s share rising from 33% to 34% over the same period, the highest of any chain tracked. The data reflects TRON’s position as the dominant blockchain for merchant acceptance and consumer-to-business payments via Visa-linked stablecoin cards.   “TRON has moved $30 trillion since launch, a scale comparable to the annual output of the U.S. economy in 2025. Crossing $30 trillion in total transaction volume is proof that TRON has become an essential infrastructure for the digital dollar economy,” said Justin Sun, founder of TRON. “Every trillion dollars that moves across TRON represents real people relying on stablecoins for payments, savings, and everyday transactions. TRON was built to support accessible, scalable digital financial infrastructure, and this milestone reflects the continued growth of that mission.”   Institutional access to TRON has broadened alongside the network’s growth. In September 2026, Canary Capital launched the Canary Staked TRX ETF, trading under the ticker TRXS. TRX spot and futures products are also available on Bitnomial, a US-regulated derivatives exchange, further broadening regulated market access. Anchorage Digital also expanded support for the TRON Network with native TRX staking and custody for TRC-20 assets through its regulated platform, while the Tokenized Hamilton Lane SCOPE Fund became the first Securitize-issued asset on the TRON network.   Additionally, the TRON blockchain was among the top 5 protocols represented in the newly launched S&P Pantera Digital Asset Index. The index was developed by S&P Dow Jones Indices and Pantera Capital, and applies a methodology centered on protocol utility, onchain liquidity, and network activity. The launch marks one of the clearest signs to date that established financial market frameworks are being extended to digital assets, applying benchmark methodologies traditionally used across equities and other asset classes to blockchain networks.   TRON’s $30 trillion transfer volume milestone underscores the network’s scale as blockchain-based payments and stablecoin settlement continue to grow. With rising activity across payments, digital assets, and institutional markets, TRON continues to serve as core infrastructure for the movement of value on-chain.   About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps.   Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of September 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 405 million in total user accounts, more than 15 billion in total transactions, and over $28 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.”   TRONNetwork | TRONDAO | X | YouTube | Telegram | Discord | Reddit | GitHub | Medium | Forum Media Contact Yeweon Park press@tron.network
content: TRON has surpassed $30 trillion in total transaction volume, solidifying its position as a leading blockchain network for stablecoins. Founder Justin Sun highlighted the network's high throughput, low costs, and deep liquidity, which drive extensive global stablecoin transfers and payments. TRON currently supports over $94 billion in circulating USDT and continues to expand its institutional access and market presence through various regulated financial products and index inclusions.
content_ta: TRON-ன் மொத்த பரிவர்த்தனை அளவு $30 டிரில்லியனைக் கடந்துள்ளது, இது ஸ்டேபிள்காயின்களுக்கான முன்னணி பிளாக்செயின் நெட்வொர்க்காக தனது நிலையை உறுதிப்படுத்துகிறது. நிறுவனரான Justin Sun, நெட்வொர்க்கின் அதிக வேகம், குறைந்த கட்டடணங்கள் மற்றும் அதிகப்படியான லிக்யூடிட்டி ஆகியவை உலகளாவிய ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் பரிமாற்றங்களை எவ்வாறு இயக்குகின்றன என்பதை எடுத்துரைத்தார். TRON தற்போது $94 பில்லியனுக்கும் அதிகமான புழக்கத்தில் உள்ள USDT-ஐ ஆதரிக்கிறது மற்றும் பல்வேறு ஒழுங்குமுறை நிதி தயாரிப்புகள் மூலம் தனது நிறுவன அணுகலை தொடர்ந்து விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது.

title: Guardis Adds Tokenized Stocks and Commodities For Trading
